The '''Ord Mantell Central Authority''' was the official government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
Following the [[Great Galactic War]], Ord Mantell sought to remain within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. However, popularity of the Ord Mantell Central Authority undermined efforts to form closer bonds with the Republic. Corruption played a key role in it ability to work with the central government. Disgusted at the corruption among government officials, some on Ord Mantell began a [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatist uprising]] against the Republic. The uprising, focused mostly in the [[Avilatan]] area, concerned the Central Authority. Its own [[Mantellian Army|army]] was not enough to contain the separatist threat, and the Central Authority asked the Republic to intervene.
